FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 44
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Donna Givens
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/24/2026
House Bill 44 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of
Human Resources by requiring the department to request a waiver from the United States
Department of Agriculture Food and Nutrition Service to authorize the department to include
hot rotisserie chicken in the definition of "eligible foods" for the Supplemental Nutrition
Assistance Program. Granting of this waiver would not directly affect state or local funding, as it
only changes the eligible foods that can be purchased and not the amount of benefits received by
SNAP beneficiaries.
